nodes.label: Sustainable materials sourcing

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Sustainable supply chains|Sustainable materials sourcing_qna_000
nodes.label: Taxonomy
nodes.question: What is the focus of most existing studies in the supply phase of an FSC in the textile industry?
nodes.answer: Most existing studies in the supply phase of an FSC in the textile industry focus on the production of sustainable fibres and materials, as well as green supplier selection practices.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Sustainable supply chains|Sustainable materials sourcing_qna_001
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: What are the key costs that a supplier incurs in the production of raw materials' cloth?
nodes.answer: The key costs that a supplier incurs in the production of raw materials' cloth include machine setup costs, ordering costs for raw cotton fabrics, holding costs for raw cotton, and holding costs for finished raw materials.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Sustainable supply chains|Sustainable materials sourcing_qna_002
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: Why is it challenging to determine the raw material cloth inventory of the supplier in this scenario?
nodes.answer: It is difficult to determine the raw material cloth inventory of the supplier because the dress manufacturer does not receive a continuous shipment of raw material cloth, unlike retailers.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Sustainable supply chains|Sustainable materials sourcing_qna_003
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: Why is the raw materials production phase considered critical in sustainability terms in the textile industry?
nodes.answer: The raw materials production phase in the textile industry is considered critical in sustainability terms because it consumes large quantities of water, generates significant wastewater, and has a great impact on the environment.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Sustainable supply chains|Sustainable materials sourcing_qna_004
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How does sourcing decisions impact sustainability in the production of athleisure apparel products?
nodes.answer: Sourcing decisions have both upstream and downstream impacts for sustainability, from the field (cotton/oil) to the floor (retail), and can have specific, measurable, and significant effects on the environment and economy.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Sustainable supply chains|Sustainable materials sourcing_qna_005
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: Why is it important to select suppliers who adhere to recycling and reusing textile waste protocols?
nodes.answer: Selecting suppliers who follow recycling and reusing protocols is crucial because it reduces the environmental impact of textile waste and promotes sustainability in the supply chain.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Sustainable supply chains|Sustainable materials sourcing_qna_006
nodes.label: Taxonomy
nodes.question: What is the significance of sustainable fibre production in the EU Eco label policy?
nodes.answer: Sustainable fibre production is a key component of the EU Eco label policy, ensuring that products are made from responsibly sourced materials, promoting environmental sustainability and reducing the impact on natural resources.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Sustainable supply chains|Sustainable materials sourcing_qna_007
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: In what way does entrusting knowledge in suppliers lead to improvements in sustainable fabric manufacturing?
nodes.answer: Entrusting knowledge in suppliers and sharing audit reports to encourage improvements in manufacturing processes leads to a more sustainable fabric manufacturing, showing a commitment to continuous enhancement.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Sustainable supply chains|Sustainable materials sourcing_qna_008
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: How does retailer demand forecasting influence the design and fabric sourcing arrangements in advance for a sustainable product?
nodes.answer: Retailer demand forecasting guides manufacturers in planning and organizing design and fabric sourcing arrangements in advance for sustainable products to meet market demand effectively.
